name: Bafoto
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.verdict: a source was named but could not be reached
earlier_scan.source_named: Hulstaert, Gustaaf 1978 'Notes sur la langue des Bafoto (Zaire)' (grammar sketch)

sources.citation: Motingea Mangulu, André. 2009. [Le réseau fluvial congolais et l'histoire des langues du bassin central], Annales Aequatoria 30: 839-988; section 'Parler des Bafotó-Wawa', pp. 953-954.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress/accent. Summarises Hulstaert 1978b: 115-116 phonetics (Kwanyama rule, consonant loss, vowel harmony not always reaching prefixes) and one tonal fact: optative 'avec abaissement du ton haut sur le radical H-BV↓-a (Hulstaert, 1978b: 126)'. Second-hand only.

sources.citation: Motingea Mangulu, André. 2007. Minorités linguistiques au programme de recherche du Centre Aequatoria. Annales Aequatoria 28: 439-455 (whole volume PDF from aequatoria.be).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bafotó appears only in a list of Hulstaert's minority-language sketches (p. 443) and as map legend item A1; no linguistic data.

sources.citation: Motingea Mangulu, André. 1993. Note sur le parler des Batswa de Bosabola (Maindombe, Zaïre). Annales Aequatoria 14: 483-501.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Describes a different pygmoid lect (Batswa of Bosabola); cites Hulstaert 1978 on Bafotó only for grammar/lexicon (pp. 115, 122, 125). Nothing on Bafotó stress.

sources.citation: Hulstaert, Gustaaf. 1990. Souvenirs au sujet de quelques groupes pygmoïdes. Annales Aequatoria 11: 436-438 (volume text held by the project under ngbu1241).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Ethnographic reminiscences; the 'Bafoto' hits in this volume are administrative history of a chefferie, no language data.

sources.citation: Vinck, Honoré. 1980. Bibliographie sur les Batswa de l'Equateur. Annales Aequatoria 1(I,2): 477-487; and Lootens, P. 1980. Vocabulaire comparé de noms d'animaux, same volume (whole volume PDF from aequatoria.be).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Hulstaert 1978 listed as a bibliographic entry only (p. 481); no Bafotó phonology.

sources.citation: Hulstaert, Gustaaf. 1978. Notes sur la langue des Bafotó (Zaïre). Anthropos 73(1/2): 113-132.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: publisher DOI, paywalled; library e-access not checked
sources.note: The only linguistic description of Bafotó (20 pp.); phonetics section pp. 115-116 with tone marking; if any statement on stress/accent exists it is here. Hulstaert's other sketches usually have a 'Tons' paragraph and sometimes a remark on 'accent dynamique'.

sources.citation: Motingea Mangulu, André. 2021. Vers une écologie linguistique des anciens chasseurs-cueilleurs du bassin central congolais. Anthropos 116(1): 137-144.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: publisher DOI, paywalled; library e-access not checked
sources.note: Most recent synthesis of the hunter-gatherer lects of the central Congo basin including Bafotó; may restate Hulstaert's prosodic facts; low chance of a stress statement in 8 pages.

sources.citation: Archives Aequatoria, Fonds Hulstaert: original field notes of the dialect surveys (microfiche, KADOC Leuven / Centre Aequatoria Bamanya); catalogue at https://www.aequatoria.be/archives/

sources.note: Hulstaert's manuscript notes behind the 1978 article; only route to more Bafotó data than the published 20 pages. Online catalogue pages show no 'Bafoto' entry, so location within the fonds is unknown.
